items.title: Spanish transport minister resigns days after deadly train crash
items.summary: At least 69 people were killed and dozens injured in the collision south of the capital, Madrid.

items.title: Seven flights across Europe targeted by suspected bomb threats
items.summary: Planes in Poland, Spain, Bulgaria and Italy have been checked for explosives following separate threats.

items.title: Binance says fake job interviews used as part of $6.3bn crypto hack
items.summary: An engineer was contacted through a legitimate job-hunting platform and invited to bogus job interviews with fake company representatives, Binance says.

items.title: NTSB says crucial plane parts found three miles from Florida crash site
items.summary: The NTSB said because the parts were found far from the accident site, they fell off before the crash.

items.title: Libya's top religious authority rules against wearing Nike clothes
items.summary: The US company was named after the Greek goddess of victory, so the Dar al-Ifta said displaying its logo was unIslamic.

items.title: Europe on alert after supermarket freezers hit by cyber-attacks in 10 countries
items.summary: Supermarkets have reported problems from Estonia and Sweden to Portugal and Italy and many retainers have been forced to discard food.
